intended: The matchmaking system groups players into lobbies of eight, and it waits up to 30 seconds to fill a lobby before it starts with bots. Skill rating ranges from 0 to 3,000, and a lobby can span at most 400 points between the highest and lowest player. If a player has waited more than 20 seconds, that range widens by 50 points every 5 seconds, up to a maximum of 800. Players on mobile are only matched with other mobile players unless the queue time passes 60 seconds, in which case cross-platform matching kicks in. All of these numbers are tunable in the config and default to the values here.
